OpenCode v2 lane: the host writes an instruction update (changed AGENTS.md) as a session_message system row it never serves by id; a /ctx-wrapup cut and a compartment stored by an older build both end on that row, and the HARD pass plus two defers after it must serve a byte-stable prefix with no degraded injection and no covered row served raw; the v2 lane runs from its own invocation (bun test tests/opencode2)

OpenCode v2 lane: a user image attached inline or by file URI, and the turns after it, must reach the provider with Magic Context loaded; OpenCode 2.0.15 rebuilds the context draft with a schema that accepts only its own Media.Asset instance, so a plain-object copy of the attachment fails the turn with 'Schema validation failed'. It also covers an image restored from before a host compaction checkpoint, in the same process and after a host restart, which must reach the provider byte-identical to the host's own rendering. The v2 lane runs from its own invocation (bun test tests/opencode2)

OpenCode v2 lane: an image the agent reads with the host's read tool comes back as a content tool result holding a file entry, which the host sends as a provider image block. With Magic Context loaded it must reach the provider as the host's own image block, never serialized into the tool output as base64 text, across a priced pass and the defer after it (whose shared prefix must be byte-identical), and after a host compaction checkpoint in the same process and after a host restart. The v2 lane runs from its own invocation (bun test tests/opencode2)
